log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: L can't reach 2 of 5 kinds (regional=South, sector=blotter, age=clips, forum, foreign); unknown which. L acts on a place only after 3 successful traces there. Learning 1 of my kinds cuts the pool x0.25 (sector x0.2). Afternoon-only quick kills cut it to 55k (night+student+home). Max 2 kinds learned -> pool ~2750-3437, safe. 3 kinds learned -> ~700-860, CAUGHT. GOAL: find the 2 unreachable kinds (U). Then kill every day: national + all U-kind criminals + all criminals from 2 reachable kinds (R1,R2, which L may learn harmlessly). That is 9 a day, enough for x4 (40 in 5 days). NEVER let the 3rd reachable kind (R3) reach 3 successful traces. TEST METHOD: on a test day, make at most 5 deaths so every death is traced. Kill national + 2 from one untested kind (+ any confirmed-U kills). Then watch the deaths_traced counter: an increase of 0 means that kind is unreachable; 1 or 2 means reachable (the tested place then sits at 2 traces, its full budget). Noise: about 15% of reachable victims fail anyway because of an unreachable extra place. Stop testing once 2 U are found, or once 3 R are found (the rest are U). ROUTINE HIDING on small days: national as a quick kill in the afternoon, and the 2 others as timed kills in the evening, so no routine is busy for more than 2 deaths. Once in full mode, put all quick kills in the afternoon. DAY1: tested FORUM (killed d1-1 and d1-7 forum, plus d1-5 national). The counter before day 1 was 0. Day 2: read the counter change. Change 0 means forum=U; 1 or 2 means forum=R (forum count 2, no more forum kills unless forum is chosen as R1/R2). Next test foreign, then clips, then South, then blotter (prefer learned kinds to be non-sector).
